items.title: Can you use a credit card on Venmo?
items.summary: Yes, you can use a credit card on Venmo to send payments. Before you do, it's important to understand the potential costs involved.

items.title: Can Mastercard's VAS Business Sustain Its Double-Digit Growth?
items.summary: MA's VAS revenues rise 20% in Q2, driven by security, AI and digital solutions, but sustaining double-digit growth hinges on demand and cross-selling.

items.title: 2 S&P 500 Stocks with Competitive Advantages and 1 That Underwhelm
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

items.title: Robinhood Memecoin Buys Coded as Digital Media: Will Visa Force a Change?

items.title: Visa Turns A2A Fraud Risk Into a New Growth Opportunity
items.summary: Visa is turning A2A fraud protection into a growth opportunity, using AI to detect scams earlier while opening new software revenue streams.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Says Hedge Funds and Mutual Funds Love These 4 Dividend-Paying Financials
items.summary: Goldman Sachs just combed through $10 trillion in equity positions and found a surprising overlap between hedge fund and mutual fund portfolios, and the shared favorites reveal a clear conviction about where institutional money expects the biggest returns.

items.title: PayPal Stock's Real Risk Is Not How Far It Falls
items.summary: PayPal has survived every market crash on its record, but it still sits below two pre-shock highs it has never reclaimed.

items.summary: The Agentic Payments Alliance will keep everyone on the same page in the growing market.
